title: 🎥 Video: The Khomeini Shahr Dam in Bashagard, Hormozgan Province, southern Iran, has overflowed after summer rains.
text:
🎥 Video: The Khomeini Shahr Dam in Bashagard, Hormozgan Province, southern Iran, has overflowed after summer rains."

"For context: Bashagard is a mountainous county in eastern Hormozgan Province, in southern Iran, north of the Gulf of Oman. The dam is located near the city of Khomeini Shahr.
